description: Japanese-minimalist general presentation template: warm stone paper, sumi ink, one vermillion accent; light-weight system sans headlines with bold accents, Georgia italic quotes, an ensō circle, vermillion hanko seals, vertical accent strips, short vermillion rules, vast whitespace and hairline footers. Cover, statement, three principles, split with framed image, stat band, quote, four-step process, agenda, offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
name: Washi
